international.title: Pat Cummins press conference live updates: Australian cricket captain speaks about Usman Khawaja’s ‘sandpapergate’ claims

There’s a very proper way to do things and improve. I think that investigation was a proper way to do it. Everyone was asked in the circumstances about a game very quickly after. So that’s for CA. I think you can maybe argue whether the judgements were fair, but what can you do? I got asked all the questions, answered them all fairly. That’s my story, so I think he’s wrong. The details really matter in that difference. So perhaps there was conversations with Cameron Bancroft around taking sandpaper out and how to do it.
